target_customer: English learners in India and emerging markets who want speaking practice
problem: Learners lack affordable speaking practice with feedback.

technical_complexity.rationale: Speech recognition and chatbot built on available APIs.

defensibility.rationale: Many similar apps and AI tutors; little proprietary data.

market_need_then: No dated demand evidence was found; the founders targeted Indian learners who want affordable English speaking practice.

brand_strength.rationale: Inc42 reports over 1 million downloads, but no independent brand coverage.

pivots.why: Stated by an aggregator profile, unverified

outcome_analysis: MySivi is active and Inc42 reports over 1 million downloads and 200K monthly users. Its YC page says it raised minimal funding, so it appears capital light. Revenue and funding claims are unverified.
notes: Website fetch returned HTTP 429. Funding: CB Insights $500K convertible note under older Sivi name and Seedtable undated March 2022 seed, aggregator only; an AEO profile claims bootstrapped with $1.2M revenue, unverified. Competitor search returned only 2026 pages. Pivot from a freelancer platform comes from one aggregator. Completeness pass: two entries recorded, a March 2022 seed from Seedtable (no amount) and a 500K convertible note from CB Insights (no date); they may describe the same YC money, so do not sum. Inc42 also states Y Combinator put in 500K. An AEO profile claims the company is bootstrapped, which conflicts.
